Our story

Why we exist.

Most ecommerce agencies are either developers who don't understand SEO, or SEO agencies who don't understand how stores are built. We started Agentix because we saw how much was left on the table when those two disciplines didn't talk to each other.

A store built without SEO architecture needs expensive remediation. An SEO strategy disconnected from how Shopify actually works produces rankings that don't convert. We built an agency where both practices are in the same room, informed by each other, from day one.

01

Build to rank

Stores architected for search from the first line of code — never retrofitted with expensive remediation after launch.

02

Rank to convert

Rankings only matter if they turn into revenue. We tune for buyers and conversion, not just traffic and impressions.

03

Convert to grow

Every win compounds — speed, CRO and retention working together so growth keeps building on itself.

What makes us different

A different kind of ecommerce partner.

01

Senior-led always

No junior account managers. Every engagement is led by a specialist with 8+ years of ecommerce experience.

02

Two disciplines, one team

Shopify development and SEO sit in the same room, informing each other — not handed between siloed agencies.

03

US market expertise

Our primary focus is US search, US buyer behaviour and the US competitive landscapes our clients compete in.

04

No lock-in

Month-to-month on ongoing services — because we'd rather earn your renewal than contractually require it.
